verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments API platform, not an agent or AI host that consumes external tools, so plugging third-party MCP servers into it is outside its product role. The evidence shows Pomelo publishes its own MCP server for installation in clients such as Cursor. That is the server role and does not show it can act as an MCP client. Its API-documentation AI assistant is also not documented as accepting MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
